levels.title: TYPESCRIPT 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: Strict TypeScript replaces any with explicit parameter and return types (number, : string), guards against NaN/Infinity via Number.isFinite(), and documents with TSDoc.

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.starter_code: interface User { id: number name: string }
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Separate interface members with `;` or newlines.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.starter_code: export function id(n: number) { return n; }

keywords_glossary.role: Replaces any with strict compile-time parameter and return types.
Rejects NaN and ±Infinity values that satisfy type number at compile time.
Documents parameters cleanly in TSDoc without redundant JSDoc type braces.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 2 spaces per block level inside the function.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Early Number.isFinite guard on line 1 followed by the template literal return.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Type colons attached to identifiers (amount: number): string and trailing semicolons.

analogous_example.title: Safe percentage formatter in strict TypeScript
analogous_example.why_it_works: Eliminates any, declares : string return type, guards with Number.isFinite(), and includes TSDoc.

levels.title: TYPESCRIPT 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: Accept untrusted payloads as unknown (never any) and narrow them with a type predicate (value is User) after checking typeof, !== null, and the in operator.

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.starter_code: function isStr(v: unknown): v is string (return typeof v === "string";)
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Use curly braces `{ ... }` for the function body.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Add a TSDoc comment above exported types.

keywords_glossary.role: Type-safe top type that forces runtime narrowing before property access.
keywords_glossary.example_inline: export function isUser(value: unknown): value is User

keywords_glossary.role: Type predicate telling the compiler that a true return narrows the argument to User.
Excludes null (where typeof is "object") before checking property existence with in.
keywords_glossary.example_inline: typeof value === "object" && value !== null && "email" in value

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 2 spaces for interface and function body, 4 spaces for wrapped boolean operands.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Each && condition placed on its own line inside return (...).
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Semicolons on interface properties and after the closing parenthesis.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Exported interface at the top and TSDoc /** ... */ above the type guard.

analogous_example.title: Type guard validating an unknown ApiToken payload
analogous_example.why_it_works: Takes unknown, rules out null, checks the key via in, and returns payload is ApiToken.
